prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Katy, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1366; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is for the claim file. Can you state your full name for the record?

A: Yes, the name is [Claimant Name].

Q: Thank you. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving on the main road in Katy, Texas, heading toward the shopping center. I was making a left turn into the parking lot entrance.

Q: What was the weather and visibility like?

A: It was clear. The roads were dry and it was still daylight, so I could see fine.

Q: Tell me what happened as you began the turn.

A: I had my left turn signal on and I waited for a gap in oncoming traffic. There was a car coming toward me, and I thought I had enough room, so I started to turn. Then a vehicle coming from the opposite direction hit the front driver's side of my car.

Q: Did you see that other vehicle before you started your turn?

A: I saw headlights earlier, but I didn't think it was close enough to be a problem. Looking back, I may have misjudged its speed.

Q: How fast were you going when you started the turn?

A: I was going slowly, maybe fifteen miles an hour. I had almost stopped at the intersection.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. My head hit the window and the airbag went off. I've been having headaches, dizziness, and trouble concentrating. My doctor told me I have a concussion.

Q: Have you been receiving treatment for that?

A: Yes, I've been seeing my doctor and I'm following her instructions to rest and avoid screens as much as I can.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get this resolved so I can get back to normal.

Q: Thank you for your cooperation. This concludes the recorded statement.
